# REQ: LANG-571 LANG-572 LANG-573 LANG-574
require "json"

module Demo
  VERSION = "1.0"

  class Greeter
    getter name : String
    @@count = 0

    def initialize(@name : String = "world")
      @@count += 1
    end

    def greet(times : Int32 = 1) : String
      text = "Hello, #{@name}! Count: #{@@count}\n"
      words = %w[alpha beta]
      opts = {key: :value, other: nil}
      return text * times if times.positive?
      raise "never" unless words.size == 2
      text
    end
  end
end

puts Demo::Greeter.new.greet(2), 0x1F, 1_000_i64, 3.14_f32, true
